transcript: Speaker A: Sir nenu interview ki vachanu, ekkadiki vellali? [Sir, I came for an interview, where should I go?] Speaker B: Madam, your interview is postponed. Did you check your email? It is rescheduled for tomorrow. Please come tomorrow, madam. Speaker A: Are wah sir. Meeru security guard ayi intha manchiga English ekkadi nunchi nerchukunnaru? [Wow sir. Being a security guard, how did you learn to speak such good English?] Speaker B: Mundu naaku kooda English lo matladadam raledu. Ee SpeakX ane app use cheyadam valla easy ga matladagalugutunnanu. Anduke office lo andaritho matladutunnanu. Naaku recent ga bonus kooda vachindi madam. Adi naa English matladatam valla. [Earlier, even I didn't know how to speak in English. By using this SpeakX app, I am able to speak easily. That's why I speak with everyone in the office. I also got a bonus recently, madam. That's because of my English speaking.] Speaker A: Emannaru? SpeakX app aa? [What did you say? SpeakX app?] Speaker B: Avunu. Aa app lo oka AI teacher untundi. Nenu free time lo 10 to 15 minutes practice chesanu. Dani valla nenu ye coaching class ki vellaledu, ye course kooda teesukoledu. [Yes. There is an AI teacher in that app. I practiced for 10 to 15 minutes in my free time. Because of that, I didn't go to any coaching class, nor did I take any course.] Speaker B: Ila choodandi. Meeru evarini kalavadaniki vacharu? [Look here. Who did you come to meet?] Speaker C: Who are you looking for? Speaker B: Eeroju interview postpone ayindi. [Today's interview is postponed.] Speaker C: The interview has been postponed today. Speaker A: Wah! Idi chala easy ga undi. Kani idi konchem costly ga untundemo kada? [Wow! This is very easy. But isn't this a bit costly?] Speaker B: Ledu madam. Ee app ki 7 days trial ki 2 rupees maatrame. [No madam. For this app, a 7-day trial is just 2 rupees.] Speaker A: Avuna? Nenu ippude ee app download chesukuntanu. Ippudu naa interview clear cheyadam evvaru aapaleru. [Really? I will download this app right now. Now, no one can stop me from clearing my interview.]
